body: This study examines the compositionality of steering vectors for language and behavioral control in large language models. Focusing on language, jailbreak, and conciseness, we investigate whether additive, training-free composition of attribute steering vectors can preserve the intended steering effect of each attribute, across four instruction-tuned models from two model families and two size scales. We find that single-attribute steering is reliable for all three attributes, but only within an appropriate combination of intervention layer and steering strength, with abstract behaviors (jailbreak, conciseness) favoring middle layers and language favoring earlier layers. We show that additive composition of two attribute vectors succeeds in steering both attributes simultaneously when each is injected at its own best-performing layer, and that this partially extends to three simultaneously composed attributes, addressing an inconsistency left open by prior work on training-free composition. We further analyze the geometric properties of these steering vectors, finding that they are approximately orthogonal in the residual stream, consistent with their compositional behavior.
summaryZh: 该研究深入探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）中用于语言和行为控制的引导向量（steering vectors）的组合性问题。研究人员调查了在不进行额外训练的情况下，通过加性组合属性引导向量是否能保持每个属性的预期引导效果。实验在两个模型家族、两种规模的四种指令微调模型上进行，结果表明，单一属性引导在特定干预层和引导强度下是可靠的。研究发现，抽象行为（如越狱、简洁性）倾向于使用中间层，而语言引导则偏好早期层。当每个属性向量被注入其最佳层时，两个属性向量的加性组合能够成功地同时引导两个属性，并且这种方法在一定程度上可以扩展到三个属性的组合，解决了先前关于无训练组合不一致性的问题。此外，研究还分析了引导向量的几何特性，发现它们在残差流中近似正交，这与它们的组合行为一致。
